label: Dips at the episode-first D1; at D2 rises when belief favors S2 and a2 reaches S2.
terms: (phase == D1) * (ep_trial == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0)
explanation: Update gate unit 4 is almost entirely timing (near 1 at D1, near 0 at GO/D2; timing R^2 ~0.998). Beyond timing: (1) a large dip (~-0.41) at D1 of the episode first trial; (2) at D2 it is higher when the ideal observer favors S2 (negative belief_lo) and when a2 commonly reaches S2, with the biggest spikes (0.4-0.6) at D2 when a2 reaches S2 right after unrewarded trials, especially after an a2 S1 unrewarded rare trial. The free fit adds those post-loss S2 interactions, a GO bump after a1 S2 rewarded, and a GO drop after unrewarded trials. Residuals at D1/GO are tiny; future reward does not matter.
